_comment: Bundled default model prices for apo. Loaded idempotently on startup; this file is the SOLE source of truth for __global__ models. Per-project overrides come via the API (ticket 10). Units: USD per 1M tokens, human-readable (e.g. 2.50 = $2.50/1M); converted to micro-USD-per-million ints at load (ticket 02 #3). Pricing keys are the canonical UsageKeys (ticket 01): input, cache_read, cache_write_5m, cache_write_1h, output, reasoning. Tier conditions use ticket 05's {keys,operator,threshold} shape; the large-context tier sums input+cache_read (cached tokens occupy the context window). updated_at is pinned from JSON (NOT now()) and used for per-model exact-equality idempotency. Maintenance: see ticket 08 — review cadence is on-demand, ownership is 'whoever ships a release'.

_format.match_pattern: anchored regex; matched via re.fullmatch(pattern, name, re.IGNORECASE)
_format.prices: USD per 1M tokens; canonical usage keys: input, cache_read, cache_write_5m, cache_write_1h, output, reasoning
_format.last_reviewed: YYYY-MM; maintainer-facing staleness signal (JSON-only, never written to DB)
_format.updated_at: ISO datetime; pinned from JSON for per-model idempotency; bump to force a re-write

models._doc: Issue #102: Opus 4.6+ cut per-dimension pricing 3x vs Opus 4.5 ($5/$25 per MTok, not $15/$75). Pattern allows a date suffix (e.g. claude-opus-4-6-20260701). The earlier 'reuse the 4.5 rates' heuristic inflated every Opus 4.6/5 run by exactly 3x.
Issue #102: Opus 5 uses the same reduced rates as 4.6 ($5/$25 per MTok), not the legacy 4.5 rates. Pattern allows a date suffix.
Cache-tiered model (golden shape #3, ticket 13 §5): exercises the cache_read / cache_write_5m / cache_write_1h distinct priced dimensions.
$1/$5 per MTok. Pattern allows a date suffix — the canonical id is dated (claude-haiku-4-5-20251001). Distinct from the Claude 3.5 Haiku entry below, which is a different model at $0.80/$4.
$3/$15 per MTok. Pattern allows a date suffix.
Introductory rates through 2026-08-31: $2/$10 per MTok. Cache dimensions use Anthropic's standard multipliers of 0.1x read, 1.25x 5-minute write, and 2x 1-hour write.
Standard rates from 2026-09-01: $3/$15 per MTok.
Same reduced rates as Opus 4.6 and Opus 5 ($5/$25 per MTok).

cache_write_5m equals the input rate: this provider charges no write premium, but the tokens that populate a cache are billed as input on the call that writes them. Callers that report usage in Anthropic buckets (input_cache_creation) land on cache_write_5m for every provider, so an absent price here silently bills those tokens at zero.
